Package com.lemarketjames.surveillance

Class SurveillanceService

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.surveillance.SurveillanceService
@Service public class SurveillanceService extends Object
Decides which orders Trading Operations are alerted to, and reads the alerts back. There are two rules: a new order that is large, and an order whose settlement was refused.

Kafka can deliver a record more than once, after a restart or a failed commit. Reviewing is therefore idempotent: an order that already has its alert for a reason is left alone, so staff never see the same alert twice.

  • Method Details

    • review

      @Transactional public boolean review(OrderSubmittedMessage order)
      Raises an alert for a newly placed order if it is large (contract C5).
      Parameters:
      order - the order, as read from Kafka
      Returns:
      whether an alert was raised; false for an order below the large-order quantity, one that already has its alert, or an event that lacks a field an alert needs

    • reviewStatusChange

      @Transactional public boolean reviewStatusChange(OrderStatusChangedMessage change)
      Raises an alert for an order that was rejected because its settlement was refused (LMKT-71). Every other status change, and a rejection for any other reason, raises none.
      Parameters:
      change - the status change, as read from Kafka
      Returns:
      whether an alert was raised; false for a change that is not a refused settlement, one that already has its alert, or an event that lacks a field an alert needs

    • latest

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public List<OrderAlert> latest(AlertFilter filter)
      Returns:
      the newest alerts that match the filter, newest first, at most 100

    • largeOrderQuantity

      public BigDecimal largeOrderQuantity()
      Returns:
      the number of shares at which an order counts as large in this environment
